rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for poisonous substances and the modern figurative choice for a person whose behaviour is harmful or hateful.

example.english: This cleaning product is toxic, so don't touch it.
example.traditional: 呢種清潔劑有毒，千祈唔好掂。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 cing1 git3 zai1 jau5 duk6 cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 dim3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on something causing harm or damage, especially an environment or situation.

example.english: Living in such a polluted environment for a long time is toxic to your health.
example.traditional: 長期喺咁嘅污染環境入面生活，對身體有害。
example.jyutping: coeng4 kei4 hai2 gam3 ge3 wu1 jim5 waan4 ging2 jap6 min6 sang1 wut6 deoi3 san1 tai2 jau5 hoi6

rows.note: Use this in medical contexts when a patient is critically ill or their condition is potentially life-threatening.

example.english: The patient is critically ill after toxic exposure and needs intensive care immediately.
example.traditional: 病人接觸過有毒物質，而家情況危重，要即刻送入深切治療部。
example.jyutping: beng6 jan4 zip3 zuk1 gwo3 jau5 duk6 mat6 zat1 ji4 gaa1 cing4 fong3 ngai4 zung6 jiu3 zik1 hak1 sung3 jap6 sam1 cit3 zi6 liu4 bou6
